$comment: Single source of truth for GitHub release asset filenames and their signing status. Consumed by scripts/docs/check-site-claims.ts (download-link + 'signed' claim verification), the release workflows (release-please.yml's download table and verify-desktop-assets) and scripts/desktop-build-lanes.test.ts, which holds these names equal to the artifactName patterns in electron-builder.yml. Update filenames HERE first. `signed` reflects whether the shipped artifact is actually code-signed/notarized today. The Windows Store package (win-x64-JxStudio.appx) is built beside the installer but is submitted to the Store rather than downloaded, so it is not listed. macOS x64 is absent: there has been no Intel Mac build since the 1.18 toolchain.
